decisions.text: type bar: categories compared by value
clustered bars: 2 series of one measure across categories (G1.56, R9-12)
nominal categories sorted by value, descending (by series expenses)
2 series side by side in each cluster, the bars touching, in the same order in every cluster: Expenses (slot 1), Budget (slot 2) (G7.5, G4.22)
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart (wrapped: Finance & Admin): vertical bars
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$600K in expenses”
wrapped onto two lines: Finance & Admin
the unit phrase on the top label: “$600K in expenses”; the top gridline starts after it
a legend above the plot, below the title, centred over the plot: labels beside the bars of a cluster would each need a leader (G5.7, G5.10, D-7)
legend entries in the order of the bars in each cluster, left to right: Expenses, Budget (G5.8, G5.14: square keys)

source.shows: the budget as a second series of bars: clustered bars with a legend, the tidy form of the book's “fugly” original, where the budget weighs as much as the expenses
